caption_link.limitation: The source provides matching numeric IDs only. It does not provide an original post URL, date, media link, or an explicit asset-to-caption key.

inspection.evidence_scope: Source-bound start, material-intermediate, and near-complete frames were extracted from the original local GIF and visually inspected; metadata came from that same source file.

motion_sampling.method: Three source-bound frame samples extracted from the original local GIF for review; no derivative was added to the corpus.
motion_sampling.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

visual_anatomy.title: A six-layer content-strategy title combines a large lightweight line with a lavender rough-display phrase-object.
visual_anatomy.layout: Six broad nested semicircular bands descend into one another from tactics to outcomes. Each band contains small category labels; three floating callout windows later bridge selected adjacent bands.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Title → identify the outer-to-inner hierarchy → scan contributor labels within a band → use the temporary callouts to understand the three paired growth positions.
visual_anatomy.typography: Large open headline, rough display tag, bold central layer labels in raised rectangles, and short sans label clusters distributed along each arc.
visual_anatomy.colour: Lavender, coral, pale blue, aqua, pink, and lavender-blue distinguish the nested layers; matching circular markers sit on the left and right arc edges.
visual_anatomy.surface: White ground, oversized soft-gradient bands with fine dark outlines, pale text pills, lifted label cards, small circular markers, and translucent modal-like callouts.
visual_anatomy.modules: Six nested hierarchy bands, many small element labels, and three relationship callouts spanning paired levels.
visual_anatomy.density: High: the nested containers carry membership and depth, allowing many elements to remain legible without a conventional table.

motion.observed_state_change: The sampled build introduces translucent callout windows that pair selected layers and fades unselected labels into the background; coloured circular markers appear to travel on the surrounding arcs before the layered overview becomes readable again.
motion.motion_job: Temporarily shift a large taxonomy from membership reading to relationship reading, then return it to a browsable hierarchy.
motion.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: See both the level at which something belongs and the trade-off created when two adjacent levels are combined.
transferable_mechanism.argument_shape: Nested taxonomy with selective relationship overlays.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Build the durable still around genuine nested membership, then use temporary overlays only to interrogate the few cross-layer relationships the reader must understand.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use only when the material really has containment or dependency layers; if categories are peers, use a comparison or map rather than concentric bands.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the six-layer content taxonomy, growth claims, semicircle nesting, label placement, relationship callouts, coloured arc markers, rough title tag, or animation sequence.

claim_boundary.note: The asset makes hierarchy and audience-growth assertions that are not independently evidenced by the supplied corpus.
